payload.body:
# Complementary caps, challenged certificates and scoped repair archives

The archive retains the failed 642 S/T substitution and its actual complementary-cap correction, the compatible-pair gap, pulse5 certificate corrections and pulse6 canonical/literal repair restrictions. Required finite-checker input tables and witnesses are included. Historical assertions and run outputs remain unreviewed evidence; no research code was executed for this edition.

This artifact-check review is inconclusive about mathematical validity. It preserves sources, their documented corrections and their limitations; it does not add a theorem, authenticate all upstream interfaces or supersede the existing RESULT.

- The old 642 allowed-loop S was not the physical cap T=K5−S; its local tables are retained as rejected historical material.
- Explicit cap colourings do not prove exact-XII support, minimum-host forcing or compatible-pair existence.
- The pulse3 distance/configuration examples do not certify a universal compatible-pair minimization principle.
- Pulse5 correction notes and the current frozen certificate coexist; unsaved prepatch bytes are not invented.
- Pulse6 fixed-C/literal and canonical selectors do not imply arbitrary adjacent-Circle or arbitrary free-completion exclusions.

Confirmed self-owned text and data: CC BY 4.0. Code: Apache-2.0. Human contribution credit: Li Hongmin. AI roles are disclosed in RIGHTS-AND-ATTRIBUTION.json. Archived source or checkpoint permission wording describes a historical state; this edition has current publication authorization.
